subject: Payment method rotation required to complete suspended invoice INV-5542
messages:
From: Jana Patel <accounts-payable@lumenfront.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: INV-5542 suspended — card declined and next steps

Hi Grace,

We received an automated notice this morning that invoice INV-5542 (Nov subscription, €46,200) was suspended after the payment attempt failed with Stripe (decline code: card_declined/hard_decline). Our records show the card on file belongs to a purchasing card that expired earlier this month. Can you confirm the preferred path to get this paid today?

Possible options from our side:
- A hosted, PCI-compliant update link so our AP team can add a new card and complete payment immediately
- If Redwood supports tokenized virtual cards, we can provision one via our TPR vendor (preferred for EU procurement rules)

We also need confirmation about VAT treatment — LumenFront is EU-registered (DE USt-Id: DE123456789). Please advise whether Redwood will reissue the invoice with reverse-charge wording or if you need additional VAT documentation before processing.

Attached: LumenFront_INV-5542.pdf (invoice copy).

Thanks,
Jana Patel
Accounts Payable
LumenFront
attachments: [LumenFront_INV-5542.pdf (pdf)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jana Patel <accounts-payable@lumenfront.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: INV-5542 suspended — card declined and next steps

Hi Jana — thanks for the heads up and for including the VAT id. Sorry for the trouble. Two quick options we can offer today so we can close the invoice: 

1) Self-service update link: I can generate a one-time, PCI-compliant card update link that will tokenize the new card directly into Stripe Billing and trigger an immediate retry. If you prefer this, I will send the link to the AP distribution list you provide and expire it after one use.

2) Tokenized virtual card: Redwood accepts tokenized instruments from approved vendors. If LumenFront will provision a virtual card, we can accept the tokenized PAN and process immediately — we just need the provisioning vendor name and a contact to coordinate the token handshake.

VAT: We can reissue the invoice with reverse-charge wording as long as we have your EU VAT number in the AP confirmation (you already supplied DE123456789). We'll attach an updated invoice to the payment confirmation email for your records.

Next steps I propose:
- Reply with preferred option (self-service link OR tokenization approach) and the AP contact to receive the link (if option 1).
- If tokenization, include vendor and token endpoint contact so Aditya can configure the minimal handshake.

I'll hold a single retry once the new instrument is provisioned; if the retry fails and a chargeback window is open we'll escalate to collections.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive — Payments
Redwood Inference
attachments: []

From: Jana Patel <accounts-payable@lumenfront.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Eric Lowe <eric@lumenfront.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: INV-5542 suspended — card declined and next steps

Hi Grace — thanks for the clear options. We prefer option 1 (self-service link) for speed — our AP team will use it this afternoon. Please send the one-time link to accounts-payable@lumenfront.com and cc eric@lumenfront.com. We do not expect to provision a virtual card today.

Also confirm: will Redwood mark the retry as a zero-amount authorization first to satisfy our bank's 3DS checks, or will you attempt a full-charge retry? Our procurement team requires a 3DS confirmation to accept the card update path.

Jana
attachments: []

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jana Patel <accounts-payable@lumenfront.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: INV-5542 suspended — card declined and next steps

Hi Jana — looping in engineering/payment ops to confirm technical details and provide the secure link.

What we'll do: 
- I'll generate a single-use, PCI-hosted update URL and send it to accounts-payable@lumenfront.com; it performs a 0€ (zero-amount) 3DS/ACS authorization during the update, then redirects your AP person to confirm. Once the card is tokenized, we'll run the full charge immediately and attach an updated invoice with reverse-charge wording.

- For audit: we will also upload minimal chargeback evidence template to your shared request (see attached) if any dispute arises during the retry window.

Action items: 
- Jana: confirm you received the link after I send it (I will send within the hour).
- Eric: when you receive the link, please complete the 3DS authorization flow and confirm successful tokenization.

Note on timing: we will attempt exactly one full-charge retry after tokenization today; if it fails due to acquirer hard-decline we will place the invoice on hold and escalate to collections per our standard terms.

Secure link (one-time): https://redwood-inference.securepay/redwood-tokenize?iid=INV-5542&one_time=true

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: [chargeback_evidence_request.docx (docx)]
